topic: EV Batteries Check Cell Health 1,000 Times Every Second
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your EV battery is a safety superstar working overtime!

Here’s the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 EV battery packs contain thousands of tiny lithium cells.
🔹 A dedicated chip monitors each cell's health 1,000 times every single second.
🔹 This constant vigilance prevents thermal issues, ensuring your electric vehicle stays super safe!
